tasks.description: Create a registration endpoint that accepts an email address and a password, validates the email and password, and rejects registration when the email is already in use. The endpoint should return a success message upon successful registration. The registration process should be secure and follow best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid email and password, when the registration endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given an invalid email, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given a password with less than 8 characters, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given an email that is already in use, when the registration endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Implement password hashing using bcrypt to store passwords securely. Never store or log plaintext passwords. The hashing function should be efficient and secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a password, when it is hashed, then the resulting hash is a bcrypt hash.
Given a plaintext password, when it is stored, then it is not stored in plaintext.

tasks.description: Create a login endpoint that accepts an email and password, verifies the password against the stored bcrypt hash, and rejects invalid credentials with a generic error message. The endpoint should return a success message upon successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then a success message is returned.
Given invalid credentials, when the login endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.
Given a non-existent email, when the login endpoint is called, then an error message is returned.

tasks.description: Implement a function to issue a signed JWT access token that encodes the user identity and an expiry upon successful login. The token should be stateless and secure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful login, when a JWT token is issued, then the token contains the user identity and an expiry.
Given a JWT token, when it is verified, then the token is valid and not expired.

tasks.description: Create a logout endpoint that ends the user's session so the token can no longer be used for authenticated requests. The endpoint should return a success message upon successful logout.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid JWT token, when the logout endpoint is called, then the token is invalidated.
Given an invalidated token, when it is used for an authenticated request, then an error message is returned.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for auth endpoints
tasks.description: Write unit tests to cover the registration, login, and logout endpoints. The tests should cover various scenarios, including valid and invalid inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
Given a test case, when it is executed, then the expected result is returned.

tasks.summary: Write integration tests for auth flow
tasks.description: Write integration tests to cover the entire authentication flow, including registration, login, and logout. The tests should cover various scenarios, including valid and invalid inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when it is run, then all tests pass.
Given a test case, when it is executed, then the expected result is returned.
